title: Frances Maria Wilbraham
dates: (1816- 26 June 1905)
---

novelist, contributor to MP (1860-85)

She was the fifth of seven daughters (there were also four sons); she was living in Chester with her mother and sisters in the 1861 and with her sisters in the 1881 census; a friend of Mrs Moberly; she contributed to CMY’s Musings over the Christian Year.

Her brother Richard Wilbraham was governor of the Royal Victoria Hospital, Netley. [LG 1906 Wilbraham of Delamere]
